title_en: Individual premium villas for sale, Petrele
description_en: Premium villa for sale, invested in detail and well thought out in the area of Petrele/ Dobresh. The villa is located in the upper part of the village, with asphalt at the door and immediately accessible from the city of Tirana. The villa has a construction area of 405m2 without counting the verandas and balconies. The villa is organized on two floors. Floor 1. Large living room. Separate kitchen. Toilets Veranda Second floor 3 Bedrooms, two of which have their own wardrobes Toilets Technical room and laundry Gym Yard Covered parking for 3 cars The villa has investments such as: Suspended ceilings Led lighting Air conditioning system Boiler system Kitchen sink Washing machine Parquet Ac5 Functional fireplace Alarm system Camera system For more details contact me
